title: Être or avoir?
goal: Describe people with the right verb: Il est grand, but Il a les yeux bleus and Elle a 40 ans.

steps.title: Picking someone up at the airport

blocks.title: Raj's sister arrives in Canada
blocks.context: Camille offers to pick up Raj's sister at the airport. She has never met her.

blocks.body: Listen for two verbs: [[est]] (from être) and [[a]] (from avoir). Where English says *is* (she **is** 28, he **is** hungry), French sometimes says *has*.

blocks.title: The basic rule
blocks.body:
- **être + adjective**: what someone *is*: [[Il est grand.]] [[Elle est mariée.]] [[Je suis canadienne.]]
- **avoir + noun**: what someone *has*: [[Il a les cheveux courts.]] [[Elle a deux enfants.]] [[J'ai trente ans.]]

The surprise for English speakers: **age, hunger, thirst and feeling hot or cold** are things you *have* in French. You literally say “I have thirty years”, “I have hunger”.

blocks.title: Side by side
head: être
avoir
English
rows: He's tall. / He has short hair.
She's dark-haired. / She has green eyes.
She's married. / She has two children.
blocks.note: Quick check: is the next word an **adjective** (grand, mariée…)? Use être. Is it a **noun** (les yeux, ans, faim…)? Use avoir.

blocks.title: Hair and eyes
blocks.pattern: avoir + les cheveux / les yeux + adjective
blocks.note: To describe someone, French says **les** (the), not *his* or *her*: [[Elle a les yeux bleus]], not [[Elle a ses yeux bleus]]. (You will still meet [[ses yeux]] elsewhere, e.g. [[J'aime ses yeux]] = I like his/her eyes: [[ses]] because [[yeux]] is plural.) The colour comes **after** and agrees with [[cheveux]] / [[yeux]] (masculine plural): add **-s**. Exception: [[marron]] never changes.

examples.fr: Elle a les cheveux blonds et courts.

blocks.title: Age
blocks.note: Always say [[ans]] (years). [[J'ai trente]] alone is not enough. To ask: [[Tu as quel âge ?]] / [[Elle a quel âge ?]]

examples.en: My baby is six months old.

blocks.title: Feelings in the body (preview)
blocks.note: These are fixed expressions. Learn them as chunks for now.

blocks.title: The classic English-speaker errors
blocks.body:
- [[Je suis trente ans]] → [[J'ai trente ans]].
- [[Je suis faim]] → [[J'ai faim]].
- [[Je suis froid]] → [[J'ai froid]]. With être, [[froid]] describes a person's **character**: [[Il est froid]] = he's cold, distant. [[Je suis chaud]] doesn't mean *I feel hot* either: in casual speech it means *I'm keen, I'm up for it*. To say you feel hot, use [[J'ai chaud]].
- [[Elle a ses yeux bleus]] → [[Elle a les yeux bleus]].
- [[Il a marié]] → [[Il est marié]]: married is an adjective.

blocks.title: ils ont or ils sont?
blocks.body:
These two sound very close, and the difference matters:

- [[ils ont]] = they **have**: a **z** sound (*eel-zon*).
- [[ils sont]] = they **are**: an **s** sound (*eel-son*).

So [[Ils ont froid]] (they feel cold) versus [[Ils sont blonds]] (they're blond). Listen for that z.

Winter in Canada means you will say [[J'ai froid !]] a lot. In casual Québec French you will also hear [[frette]] for *very cold*, most often in [[Il fait frette !]] (It's freezing out!). Recognise it, but say [[J'ai froid]] yourself.

blocks.title: Listen and repeat
blocks.note: Say each pair and feel the difference between est and a.

lines.fr: Il est grand. Il a les yeux bleus.
lines.en: He's tall. He has blue eyes.

lines.tip: No liaison: cheveux starts with a consonant.
The t of trente links to ans: “tran-tan”.

blocks.explain: The z sound in *eel-zon* means [[ils ont]]: they feel cold.
The s sound in *eel-son* means [[ils sont]]: they're blond.

blocks.fr: Elle a les yeux marron et les cheveux courts.
blocks.en: She has brown eyes and short hair.

blocks.prompt: A friend will meet someone you know at the bus station. Describe that person so your friend can recognise them: age, appearance, and one personality trait.

models.label: Model answer
models.fr: C'est mon cousin, Karim. Il a vingt-cinq ans. Il est grand et brun. Il a les cheveux courts et les yeux marron. Il est un peu timide, mais il est très sympa.
models.en: It's my cousin, Karim. He's twenty-five. He's tall and dark-haired. He has short hair and brown eyes. He's a bit shy, but he's really nice.

blocks.prompt: Write a short message to a friend who will pick up a family member of yours at the airport. Describe the person.
checklist: Use avoir at least twice (age, hair, eyes, children…)
Agree the colours: les yeux bleus, les cheveux noirs

models.label: Model answer
models.fr: Salut Alex ! Merci ! Ma mère arrive à dix-huit heures. Elle a soixante ans. Elle est petite et elle a les cheveux courts et blonds. Elle a les yeux bleus. Elle est très gentille, et elle parle un peu français.
models.en: Hi Alex! Thanks! My mother arrives at 6 p.m. She's sixty. She's short and she has short blond hair. She has blue eyes. She's very kind, and she speaks a little French.

summary:
- Use **être + adjective** ([[Il est grand]]) and **avoir + noun** ([[Il a les cheveux courts]])
- Give age with avoir: [[Elle a quarante ans]], never *est … ans*
- Describe hair and eyes: [[Elle a les yeux bleus]], with les, and [[marron]] that never changes
- Recognise [[avoir faim / soif / froid / chaud]], and avoid [[Je suis froid]]
